svg.title: Identity and access in the landing zone: who, where identities live, how sign-in is protected, and what they can do
svg.desc: Four rows from top to bottom, each leading to the next. 1, who needs access: employees, administrators with separate cloud-only accounts, external users through Microsoft Entra B2B, and applications using managed identities. 2, where identities live: Microsoft Entra ID, with cloud-only accounts or accounts synchronized from on-premises Active Directory by Microsoft Entra Connect or Cloud Sync; and an identity platform subscription with Active Directory Domain Services domain controllers or Microsoft Entra Domain Services, only for applications that need Kerberos or NTLM. 3, protect sign-in and admin access: multifactor authentication, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management, and emergency access accounts. 4, what they can do: Azure RBAC, a role given to a group at a scope: management group, subscription or resource group. Match the scope to the job. Two notes at the bottom: Microsoft Entra ID roles manage the directory and Azure RBAC roles manage Azure resources; Azure Policy is separate and is assigned at the management group. Icons are official Azure and Microsoft Entra icons.
